subject: integration
name: Orivon's Swarm node
summary: Orivon's WebAssembly build of the Ant Swarm light node (Apache-2.0), run on this computer with 250 peers found through Swarm's bootnodes. Orivon checks every chunk it returns against its address, so a peer can slow it and never change content. Its own key is sealed by the secret store, and a gate lets it send only a purchase of storage the person confirmed, to the postage contract. Nothing checks that the network keeps every chunk uploaded. Level 4: no server is relied on. Not private: peers see the IP address and the chunks asked. Judged here by its publisher.
